inputs.text: Character concept turnaround sheet for a cozy farming video game, ink and watercolor storybook illustration, thin warm sepia-brown ink linework of even weight around every shape, transparent watercolor washes inside the lines, light paper texture, warm palette of sage green, ochre, terracotta and cream, gentle warm sunlight from the upper left, charming cozy european picture-book style. The same character shown three times standing side by side in a neutral relaxed pose, full body, evenly spaced, same scale: front view, right side profile view, back view. The character: a young adult farmer who just left an office job in the city: short wavy chestnut hair, kind tired-but-hopeful face with rosy cheeks, cream linen shirt with rolled-up sleeves, sage green work overalls, terracotta red neckerchief, small brown leather satchel across the body, sturdy brown boots; slightly chibi game proportions, about 3.5 heads tall, gender-neutral look. Plain warm cream paper background, soft contact shadow under each figure, no text, no labels, no letters.
